BiblicalUsage: Eltekon is a place in Palestine. In Joshua 15:59, the text says "and Eltekon." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eltekon matters because God's story happened in real places, and Eltekon is one of them.
